summary: The writer-hold report names each flush hook a projection pass runs as its own stage, so a long receive hold says which domain's catch-up it spent its time in

schema.detail: No table or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: Only the stage names in the writer-hold report change: an 'after-projection' stage now keeps only what no hook took, beside one stage per flush hook (custom, identities, resources, completion-health, glass-heads, directive-notes, agent-messages, limits, arrangements, ordered-membership) and 'lease-renewals'. A lend keeps up to 24 stages, up from 16, so a projection pass's commit and release stay named rather than folding into 'other'.
